config.js_code: let url = '<BANK_CREATE_CUSTOMER_API>'; let respData = null; await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer <LICENSE_KEY>' }, body: JSON.stringify({ tenantId: '<TENANT_ID>', communityId: '<COMMUNITY_ID>', authModuleId: '<AUTH_MODULE_ID>', faceCompareScore: params.nodes.liveid_capture_onboarding.face_compare_score, livenessScore: params.nodes.liveid_capture_onboarding.liveness_score }) }).then((response) => response.json()).then((result) => {respData = result}).catch((error) => {throw new Error(error)}); return {respData};

Note: Please continue to the login page to access your new account.

config.js_code: let url = '<BANK_LOGIN_API>'; let respData = null; await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer <LICENSE_KEY>' }, body: JSON.stringify({ tenantId: '<TENANT_ID>', communityId: '<COMMUNITY_ID>', authModuleId: '<AUTH_MODULE_ID>', username: params.nodes.login_form.email }) }).then((response) => response.json()).then((result) => {respData = result}).catch((error) => {throw new Error(error)}); return {respData};
if (params.nodes.check_customer_login.respData.message === 'User not found') { next = 'login_invalid'; } else { next = 'qr_passwordless_login'; } return {next};
